rows.label: bf06500100_0030
rows.name: Of course! I'm Thunderclap Zeke, you know?

rows.label: bf06500100_0040
rows.name: Who do you think you're dealing with?

rows.label: bf06500100_0060
rows.name:
Anyway, let's hit them once
more and knock them out.

rows.label: bf06500100_0080
rows.name:
Here I go!
Thunderous Power Descends!

rows.label: bf06500100_0110
rows.name:
Seems the name Thunderclap isn't just for show.
That's the first time I've missed a vital point.

rows.label: bf06500100_0115
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]ぜぇ…ぜぇ…ぜぇ…ぜぇ…ぜぇ…ぜぇ…

rows.label: bf06500100_0150
rows.name:
Don't worry yourself... It's
just a scratch, really...

rows.label: bf06500100_0190
rows.name: Don't mind me, I'm just a spectator.

rows.label: bf06500100_0200
rows.name:
He insisted on doing this
with his own hands today...

rows.label: bf06500100_0220
rows.name:
Correct. I will be taking both the
Sanctus Chain and the Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf06500100_0230
rows.name:
You just try and take 'em!
I know you're strong...

rows.label: bf06500100_0240
rows.name:
but there's no way we're
giving you Homura or Hikari!

rows.label: bf06500100_0250
rows.name: Strong words. But words do little.

rows.label: bf06500100_0260
rows.name: If that's what you want, then instead of words...

rows.label: bf06500100_0265
rows.name: prove it with your own strength.

rows.label: bf06500100_0290
rows.name:
There's no change in the surrounding
ether energy, mo.

rows.label: bf06500100_0300
rows.name:
That energy is bursting out
from inside his body, mo.

rows.label: bf06500100_0310
rows.name:
So he's like Homura and the others? Where could
that much energy be coming from?

rows.label: bf06500100_0320
rows.name: Could it be the energy of the anger inside him?
